title: Prepare a complete frozen WP1 text and preservation key for independent checking
body:
## Goal
Resolve the next concrete WP1 preparation gap: prepare a complete, source-derived text/preservation/answer key package for separate independent checking before either comparison arm. Expected gain: benchmark/writing/wp1-key-0115.json and wp1-key-0115.md freeze every applicable requirement and source locator, or identify exact unresolvable IDs. This is preparation, not a trial, product code, evaluator or readiness approval. No session can run LabVIEW. Native/save-version/build/behavior authority remains unavailable.
## Acceptance
- [ ] Check starting Git commit/tree and relevant source hashes. Derive the key from the pinned original, requested operation and authoritative protocol, never candidate answers or emitted edited artifacts. Preserve the original and license. Record the source revision, complete read-input SHA256 manifest, precise requirement IDs and original locators.
- [ ] Inventory every WP1 text, preservation, answer and grounding obligation in method.json and the protocol. Give each applicable ID an independently source-derived expected result, original/output citation rule, exact comparison or explicit human adjudication rule, uncertainty, and status. Document coverage of unsupported extra claims and contradictions, including honest limitations; C1 cannot be settled by structured flags or substring checks. Unknown native outcomes remain separate, never inferred from XML declarations.
- [ ] Freeze the exact proposed task prompt, original and allowed-input manifests, output/dependency inventory policy and key revision. Distinguish proposed workspace/arm paths from actual allocated workspaces. Do not choose or invent model/quota/budget/repetition allocations, execute either arm, emit a changed project, or claim hidden keys: all files remain public development material in one familiar-possible lineage.
- [ ] Write wp1-key-0115.md explaining the key derivation and a per-ID checklist for a later separate checker, including disagreement/blocking handling, required independent approval and all still-missing native/isolation/allocation/owner prerequisites. Set independent approval and trial readiness explicitly pending. Do not approve the author's own key or repeat #557 integration review. If an ID cannot be grounded, preserve its unavailable status and exact next evidence rather than fabricate completeness.
- [ ] Add benchmark/writing/check_wp1_key_0115.py as a read-only stdlib package-integrity/coverage checker with focused in-memory counterexamples for missing/duplicated IDs, bad source pins/locators, and unsupported native/readiness promotions. It must independently cross-check obligations against current source method/protocol, not merely compare duplicate author lists. Report its limits: integrity/coverage checks do not certify narrative truth or independent approval. Save actual results at benchmark/writing/wp1-key-0115-verification.json.
- [ ] Change only these four new paths: benchmark/writing/wp1-key-0115.json, benchmark/writing/wp1-key-0115.md, benchmark/writing/check_wp1_key_0115.py and benchmark/writing/wp1-key-0115-verification.json. Preserve method, controls, verifier, historical reviews/probes/checkers, original/license, integration provenance and preparation.json. Run the existing current method verifier once and the new verification command. Record actual results and changed-file scope against starting commit.
## Verification
python3 -I benchmark/writing/check_wp1_key_0115.py
## Context
- benchmark/writing/README.md, WP1 integration 0112: explicitly requires a separate preparer/checker to freeze every text/preservation/answer ID and input before either arm; native authority remains missing.
- benchmark/writing/review-0113-provenance.md: #561 preserved exact #557 review; no integration drift, scoped CLEAR only, C1 retained. Do not replay historical probes.
- docs/perpetua/evaluation.md and roles.md: independent key/control review and owner method acceptance precede product work.
## Budget
Read benchmark/writing/README.md, selected WP1/requirements/oracle/paired/coverage sections of benchmark/writing/method.json, benchmark/project-text-writing-0109.md and relevant original/pins/license it names; benchmark/protocol.md, baseline/runner-contract.md and precision/README.md only relevant key/answer/preservation/input obligations; docs/perpetua/{evaluation,roles}.md; benchmark/writing/review-0113-provenance.md and C1 section of review-0113.json if needed. Hash complete inputs without dumping large JSON. Do not read whole review probe JSON, history, journal, unrelated projects or global gap maps. Keep command output short and report early if pins disagree. Parent commits accepted writes; compare scope to starting commit. Verification must use repository files only, no .session paths or LABVIEW_ENVIRONMENT.
